_comment: Facet vocabulary for GET /api/openings/browse. Single source of truth — the browse service reads it, nothing hardcodes these lists. Levels and styles read the style tags in api/data/style-tags.json (docs/style-taxonomy.md): a style matches when its axis holds one of its values, so an opening can be under more than one (Sharp and Gambit). Positions with no tags are under none.

retiredStyles._comment: Style values from before docs/style-taxonomy.md, kept so an old link still filters. Each goes to its nearest axis value.
